reviews.text: Horrible experience. No redeeming qualities. Do not use this service!

We used Urban Tailz for our dog Oakley for years while we lived in the city and always had a great experience.

Oakley can be a little reactive around other dogs, so it was really important to us to have walkers who understood that, took the time to learn her habits, and let her get comfortable with them. Every walker we worked with did exactly that, and we always felt like she was in good hands.

They were also incredibly reliable. If our regular walker was ever unavailable, Urban Tailz was almost always able to find someone else to fill in, which made things so much easier for us.

Great people, dependable service, and a team that genuinely takes the time to get to know your dog. We’d absolutely recommend Urban Tailz!

i had a trip planned for out of state months in advance when my  rabbit went into gi stasis a week before. that was money i couldn't get back, but with the little time i had, i was able to recover her at home with the vet's instructions. her care extended into my trip, and urban tailz pulled through to help my father administer medication while he was housesitting! i'm beyond grateful for the amazing care my bunny bugs got! she's a little sassy, but the sitter handled her like a pro! thank you again!

Urban Tailz has been an excellent dog walking service for us. All their staff is so sweet and patient with our dog, and they are great with special requests. Management is also wonderful and accommodating. Would recommend their services!

Kathryn and I can’t say enough good things about Urban Tailz, and specifically our walker, Athena. Leaving our dog, Shasta, in someone else's hands can be stressful, but Athena’s professionalism and the business's transparency put us completely at ease while we’re at work.

We especially love the detailed communication we receive every day. It’s so helpful to get real-time updates on when Athena arrives and leaves, including a GPS map of the exact route they took. The daily report—letting us know about potty breaks, how well-behaved she was, and the treats she received—is such a thoughtful touch. Plus, getting 3–5 photos after every walk is always the highlight of our workday!

We always know Shasta is in the best hands possible. If you’re looking for a reliable, tech-forward, and caring dog walking service, we can't recommend Urban Tailz enough.

My dog and I can not say enough wonderful things about this company! They are so kind, flexible, and knowledgeable. It has made scheduling so easy for my always changing schedule. They give wonderful and in depth updates about your pet after each walk. 10/10 would recommend to everyone who needs a dog walker!

We’ve been using Urban Tailz for our dog for years and have had nothing but wonderful experiences. He’s a bit challenging and they’ve been so kind and patient with him. Highly recommend for dog walking and in-home pet sitting!

As someone that has worked in the pet care industry, I am very selective about who I trust my dogs with, and I HIGHLY recommend Urban Tailz!
They’re very thorough with the onboarding process. They’re highly responsive and excellent with communication. They are also very accommodating to my particular requests and my dogs’ quirks.
We love LaShaunti our dog walker! She’s so sweet and good with our pup and takes the cutest pictures on their walks! 10/10

We've been using UT for 6+ years and they are fantastic.  Great flexibility and support via the app, which I love.  The report after each walk is amazing.  Both of our rescue pups were/are tricky to walk, and the walkers have been professional and able to handle them.
Urban Tailz has been great to work with.  They're professional, reliable, and as flexible as they can be.  I recommend them to everyone who needs help with their pets.

Urban Tailz is a great service and offers a range of care and flexibility making them borderline essential for a dog in the city!

On a normal walk, they take care to pair trained walkers with dogs over long periods to build relations and trust. Lexi has been walking  Leo for 6 months and he LOVES her. The substitute walkers are fantastic too and go out of their way to make Leo feel comfortable. It is great knowing that Leo is getting perfect, 1:1 care on walks.

Where Urban Tailz excels even further is on pop-up needs. Urban Tailz has been great for requesting additional walks for Leo! It’s fantastic knowing he can always get attentive, high quality care whenever needed!

Plus, Lexi always takes the best photos.

They have been wonderful! Been using urban tailz for many years and I highly recommend. Great at handling both challenging dogs and senior dogs. Always able to accommodate all my requests. Very dependable and quality walkers who are trained!
Alexis is amazing. Out lil buddy loves him and she’s a delight.  Above and beyond she’s a great picture taker so.. 5 stars all day.

My pup and I LOVE this place. The walkers are incredibly thoughtful and professional, and also excellent photographers!
